scripts.synth: npm run synth:beta && npm run synth:production && npm run synth:pipeline
scripts.synth:beta: npm run build && cdk synth -c stage=beta --output cdk.out/beta
scripts.synth:pipeline: npm run build && cdk synth -c pipeline=true --output cdk.out/pipeline
scripts.synth:production: npm run build && cdk synth -c stage=production --output cdk.out/production
